Docket 1.3.142

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *The free command line now fails a build.* `docket audit` without a key exited 0 every time, so a deploy gate
  built on it never failed, even on a site that told search engines not to index its homepage, or one that did not
  answer at all. It now exits 2 at your `--fail-on` threshold, exactly as the paid version does. It says the
  threshold was reached, and the paid version says which problems reached it.
- *A free `docket diff` no longer says "No change" when there is one.* Comparing a clean site with a broken one
  printed "No change in findings" and passed. It now says how many regressions and improvements there are, and
  `--fail-on` fails the build on the real regressions. Which ones they are is in the paid version.

99 checks across 13 areas.
